data_description.scan_interval: How often every sensor refreshes except the dashboard card's own "my location" mode: the home nearest stop, extra stops, and every per-device nearest sensor. "My location" has its own separate refresh setting in the card.

data.notify_leave_now: Notify when it is time to leave home

data_description.notify_targets: Pick one or more notify services/devices (e.g. your phone's mobile_app) to also receive these notifications on, in addition to the Home Assistant notifications panel. Leave empty to only use the notifications panel.
data_description.arriving_threshold_min: The Bus arriving sensor turns on when the next bus is this close.
data_description.notify_leave_now: Uses the walking time to the nearest stop. Sends one notification when you should leave.
data_description.walk_buffer_min: Extra minutes added to the walk so you do not arrive just as the bus does.

data.notify_new_alerts_enabled: Notify when a new alert appears

add_stop_search.title: Search stop
add_stop_search.description: Type a stop name or ID and choose one from the list.

add_stops_bulk.title: Add stops (paste list)
add_stops_bulk.description: For anyone who already knows the stop IDs. One line, entries separated by " | ": id,name,line — e.g. 1234,Urzaiz,C1 | 5678,Colón

add_commute.title: Add commute
add_commute.description: VigoBus plans the best bus option shortly before you usually leave and notifies you.

error.invalid_extra_stops: Some extra stop values are invalid. Use id,name,line | 1234 | urzaiz.
error.invalid_stop_search: No matching stops found for that search.
error.invalid_commute: Fill in a name, a destination and a time (HH:MM).
